title: Emacs Bedrock 2.0
summary: Emacs Bedrock 2.0 is a minimal yet powerful Emacs configuration framework that provides a solid foundation for customizing and extending the Emacs editor. This major version update likely brings improved modularity, better defaults, and enhanced tooling for developers who want a clean starting point for their Emacs setup.
problem_solved: Provides a well-structured, minimal Emacs configuration foundation to avoid starting from scratch or dealing with bloated starter kits.
why_valuable: It offers a balanced approach between customization and simplicity, helping developers build efficient, personalized Emacs environments with less configuration overhead.
